items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in relation to authorizing distinctive license plates for recipients of the conspicuous service cross
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S2564

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the vehicle and traffic law, in
relation to authorizing distinctive license plates for recipients of
the conspicuous service cross

 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :

This bill authorizes the Department of Motor Vehicles to issue
distinctive license plates for recipients of the New York State
Conspicuous Service Cross.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :

The vehicle and traffic law is amended by adding a new section 404-x
authorizing the issuance of distinctive plates for conspicuous service
cross recipients.

 JUSTIFICATION :

The award of the Conspicuous Service Cross is based on a prior
military decoration award. Conspicuous Service Cross recipients are
combat veterans who served their country with valor. Many of these
veterans were wounded in battle while defending our country. It is
only fitting to allow special recognition for their courage as they
faced such danger defending our freedom.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

2016: S.8179 - Died in Rules
2014: A.4927 - Died in Veterans' Affairs.
2012: A.1091 - Died in Veterans' Affairs. S.235 Died in
Transportation.
2009-2010: A.5206 - Died in Veterans' Affairs.
2007-2008: A.6760 -  Died in Veterans' Affairs.
2006: A.243-B - Passed Assembly.
2004: A.4670-A Passed Assembly.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
One hundred and twentieth day after it shall have become a law.
